remarks:
1967 Niagara St, Buffalo, NY 14207 — Welcome to 1967 Niagara Street in Buffalo’s historic Black Rock neighborhood. This 1925 2-family home offers 4 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms with approximately 1,364 square feet of living space on a 3,267-square-foot lot. 

The property sits on a convenient Niagara Street corridor with access to I-190, the Niagara River, local parks (including Tow Path Park and the Riverwalk), bus lines, and everyday amenities. Black Rock has seen renewed interest with mixed-use activity, dining, and proximity to downtown Buffalo and the Peace Bridge. 

This is a solid opportunity for a first-time buyer, owner-occupant looking to add sweat equity, or an investor in an established Blackrock neighborhood. 

Upper is occupied, and lower is rehabbed and ready to rent or have owner occupier move in.
